That is, Allah is described with complete sovereignty, and His sovereignty is without beginning and without end; as for the sovereignty He gives to the servant in this world, it is originated and passes away; and al-Malik is among the most beautiful names of Allah.

He is the One free of any partner, child, and attributes of deficiency such as need for place and time, for He is their Creator and of what is besides them; and He, blessed and exalted, is free of deficiencies and pure of faults; and al-Quddus is among the most beautiful names of Allah.
